regime_context: The detector shows a two-layer defensive/healthcare leadership structure: Big Pharma is the headline narrative (eligible, durable, trend-confirming, but crowded at z=1.5), backed by broad Health Care and Defensives/Staples strength. The absolute-trend gate helped on this market's history (gate_helps=true), so trend eligibility is a real risk-control leg here. Rotational breadth is narrowing (17/49 eligible, absorption 0.32, directional=false), so this is a dispersion-thin tape, not a broad regime; the top momentum rank (Memory/HBM) is ineligible, confirming it is a noisy leader without staying power. Track record shows a 56.5% hit rate but only 41.3% directional accuracy over n=138 — lean low on directional calls.
emerging_watch: Watch whether the 'narrowing' rotation (0.35 eligible, one_narrative=false) begins to broaden back out via Big Pharma's challenger status: if the Memory/HBM leader (score 1.855, breadth 0.0, ineligible) regains eligibility and breadth turns positive, that would retire the defensive/healthcare concentration watch and put the AI-hardware leadership back on the board.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the headline narrative with strongest durability breadth (1.0), absolute-trend gate eligibility, and 'trend' Hurst tag. Its crowding (z=1.5) cautions against adding size, but the trend-gate validated risk control supports staying with the established leader. Detector legs used: trend-gate eligibility + durability_bar 0.84 + breadth 1.0.
theses.dissent: Crowding z=1.5 plus headline status with weight 0.25 and r10 of only 0.0178 suggests the leadership is mature and vulnerable to a momentum-chasing top; bid-ask freshness is low.

falsifier.text: PPH lags XLV by 3% over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Health Care equal-weight shows a similarly durable trend profile (durability_bar 0.78, breadth 0.883, trend) behind the Big Pharma leader. It carries the same crowding caution (z=1.55). Detector legs: trend-gate eligibility + durability_bar + breadth.
theses.dissent: The wider healthcare leadership may be an extension of a crowded defensive bid — once Big Pharma stalls, the equal-weight sector has less idiosyncratic momentum of its own.

falsifier.text: XLV breaks below its own 50-day simple moving average and closes there for three consecutive sessions before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Defensives
theses.thesis: Defensives (Consumer Defensive/Utilities composite, unscorable) shows durable trend health (durability_bar 0.83, breadth 0.944, trend) and is eligible. The absolute-trend gate is validated here historically, so maintaining an eligible defensive stance is consistent with the risk-control edge rather than a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Crowding z=1.57 is at the high end; defensive leadership often marks a late-cycle/episodic risk-off bid rather than a durable growth story.

falsifier.text: XLP closes below its 20-day moving average while XLY outperforms by more than 4% before the check-by date.
